answer: By the timber of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The terrace holds work receipts rather than names, so the trellis of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
